name: modern-genz
label: Modern · Gen-Z
description: Parameterised by 4 coordinated palettes. Customer picks ONE palette swatch — that's the only Gen-Z customisation control. The palette sets all 6 color roles together (PRD §10.3 + §6.3) plus a 3-slot dotCycle for user-entry rotation. New palettes ship as additional files under storage/calendar_palettes/genz/ — no code change.

_meta.rationale: Per PRD §4.0 (minimal customer controls), Gen-Z customers see one segmented palette picker, not six separate colour pickers. Coordinated palettes prevent the 'ugly mix' failure mode that an open-ended picker would invite.
